fields.System.Title: RET-302 — Attach evidence to an inspection
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a quality inspector, I want to attach photographs and notes to an inspection, so that
a supplier claim or customer dispute can be supported later.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given an inspection, then one or more images and free-text notes can be attached.
  • - Given a grade of damaged or scrap, then at least one piece of evidence is required.
  • - Given an attachment, then it records who added it and when, and cannot be deleted.
  • - Given an inspection, then its evidence is retrievable with the return record.
  • - Given storage, then attachment size and format are constrained.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | returns, platform |
| Tables | inspection, attachments |
| Risks | Scrap decisions with no supporting evidence |
| Tests | integration |
